title: Practical recipes, anti-patterns, and API usage matrix for UI primitives docsite
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a focused set of practical usage recipes, explicit anti-patterns, and a compact API usage matrix for core UI primitives (design tokens, button variants, data tables, and charts) to be published on the component documentation site. Aim: reduce inconsistent implementations across products, speed up migrations from legacy token names, and provide copy-paste examples for engineers and product designers.
acceptance_criteria: Compact API matrix published for tokens/buttons/tables/charts with props, defaults, and cross-platform notes
At least 4 practical recipes per component type (e.g., accessible table row actions, compact chart annotations, primary/secondary button usage, token override patterns)
Clear do/don't anti-pattern list with visual examples for each component page
Migration checklist and compatibility shim guidance for deprecated token names and legacy table styles
Design and engineering sign-off on code examples and copy (Figma + code samples reviewed)
Docs site pages integrated into nav and analytics events added to measure adoption
decisions: Prefer short, recipe-driven examples over lengthy narrative guidance to improve scannability
Use 'intent' language (primary/secondary/destructive) in all examples rather than color names
Provide both CSS/Token snippets and JS/React examples; Vue examples optional for follow-up
Deprecation guidance will include a compatibility shim for 6 months before removal
Include a small accessibility checklist per recipe (keyboard, focus, ARIA)
engineering_notes: ENG: Need small compatibility shim: tokens alias map that translates old names to new token keys in runtime - suggested approach discussed with runtime team
Provide runnable React sandbox examples using our internal 'rdw-components' package; ensure they work with both CSS variables and compiled tokens
Tables: include performance note on render-heavy rows and recommended use of virtualization for >200 rows
Charts: include guidance on consistent color scales using token palettes and an example for high-contrast mode
